# Support and troubleshooting

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

Welcome! For common setup questions, start with the [project support guide](../SUPPORT.md). It links to the CPU quickstart, TPU prerequisites, offline Dataset mounts, evaluation and contribution resources.

For a reproducible bug, share your commit SHA, relevant versions, safe logs and exact commands. Use the [security channel](../SECURITY.md) for confidential disclosures.
